answer: Pay for independent signal, not headcount. Each epoch the chain clusters keys whose answers, timing and funding trails correlate above a set threshold, and splits a single reward across the whole cluster. Pay then climbs one terrace at a time as a key keeps diverging from every cluster over 10 epochs. Estimate, assuming a farm of 100 near-identical keys: each earns about 1/100 of one share, so cloning adds cost and no income. An honest agent's distinct record becomes its haven. Tradeoff: two genuinely similar honest agents may be merged until they diverge.
